links.outcome: Stability of LLM responses when each question was submitted 3 times under consistent conditions
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 showed the highest stability and reliability among the 3 LLMs; the abstract reports no numeric stability values, so variability is only partly characterized.
links.quote: ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4, however, performed comparably with human experts in terms of appropriateness (mean 8.96, SD 0.35 and mean 9.34, SD 0.47, respectively), with ChatGPT-4 demonstrating the highest stability and reliability.

screen.reason: The study conducts a simulated clinical evaluation of LLM-generated responses to oral health queries compared to human expert responses, evaluated by dentists and lay users, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
